svg.aria-label: I build simulators of patients and scanners. I model how PET and CT measure the body. I turn every detection into raw data. I correct the measured data. I reconstruct images from raw data. I remove blur and noise with deep learning. I deliver results clinicians can trust.
svg.title: From patient to insight
svg.text: I build simulators of patients and scanners.
I model how PET and CT measure the body.
I turn every detection into raw data.
I reconstruct images from raw data.
I remove blur and noise with deep learning.
I deliver results clinicians can trust.
